data.name: Wyatan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'Wig' meaning 'Battle' and 'Than' meaning 'God' or 'Man'. Wyatan represents a warrior who trusts in God or a man who embodies bravery.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes faith and courage in the face of adversity.
data.numerology_meaning: Nurturing, loving, and friendly. Wyatans have a natural ability to help others and are deeply committed to their loved ones.

data.cultural_impact: The name Wyatan signifies a strong and brave individual. In medieval European societies, names were often reflective of the societal or personal values of the time. With the name Wyatan, one could have aspired to a warrior's identity or have wanted to remember their family's history of bravery and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Wyatan lies in the trust in God or the embodiment of the divine in an individual. The name carries the reminder that strength and bravery do not solely rely on human capabilities but also on faith and trust in a higher power. This name would have appealed to those seeking spiritual growth and courage in their daily lives.
